name: Bone-Crown March
introDiscord:
Skeletons stand so densely ahead that their overlapping spines resemble
crowns.

Bone-Crown Behemoths march between them like living monuments among
dead giants.
introTwitch:
Skeletons stand so densely ahead that their overlapping spines resemble
crowns.

Bone-Crown Behemoths march between them like living monuments among
dead giants.

bone-crown-march-approach.prompt: Three routes cross beneath enormous crown-shaped bones.

left.message: Star Candies rest beneath a scale.

right.message:
Shizuki's bottle:

'Official crown inspection.

Every crown too large.

Glimmer suggests wearing vertebra.

Glimmer banned from royal outfitting.'

forward.message: A Bone-Crown Behemoth steps between two towering skeletons.

left.message: A Behemoth crosses the path carrying bone fragments across its shell.

right.message:
One Berry rests inside Shizuki's attempted crown.

It is simply a small curved bone with ribbon tied around it.

Caption:

'Royalty achieved.

Glimmer unimpressed.'

forward.message: A navigator's chest rests beneath the crowned skeleton.

left.message: A strongbox sits beneath an arch of enormous spines.

right.message: A Bone-Crown Behemoth guards the deepest skeleton.

forward.message:
Shizuki's bottle reads:

'Royal recovery potion.

Exactly same as normal potion.

Branding matters.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave Her Majesty's Completely Normal Medicine untouched.

bossPromptDiscord:
The Bone-Crown Behemoths kneel.

Behind them, an enormous silhouette rises beneath the crownlike skeleton
of a Leviathan.

Use /yes to enter Crowned Skeleton Deep or /no to conclude the royal
tour before meeting local nobility.
bossPromptTwitch:

boss.revealText:
A colossal Behemoth rises beneath the ivory crown.

Ossuary Behemoth reveals itself!

completionText:
The Ossuary Behemoth returns among the bones.

Shizuki's tiny crown remains nearby.

Long may she reign.
